glosses.notes: The money system a place uses, including what people use to buy, sell, save, and compare value.

examples.sentence: 新闻里说，这个小国的货币这几年一直不太好，所以很多人买东西以前都先看今天要花多少钱。
老师讲到古代货币的时候，把几种旧钱放在一起给大家看，让我们明白东西怎么一步一步变成今天这样。
出发以前先换好当地货币的人，到那边以后连买水、坐车和吃饭都要比临时找地方换钱的人轻松得多。

example_translations.translation: The news said that this small country's currency has not been doing well these past few years, so many people check first how much they will need to spend that day before buying anything.
When the teacher got to ancient currency, she put several kinds of old money together for everyone to look at, so we could understand how things slowly became what they are today.

People who exchange the local currency before leaving have a much easier time buying water, riding around, and eating after they arrive than people who have to look for a place to exchange money at the last minute.

glosses.notes: A vehicle for carrying goods, materials, or large loads rather than passengers.

examples.sentence: 凌晨那辆货车刚开进院子，门口等着拿东西的人就全走过去了，因为今天大家都怕来得太晚。
路口那辆货车坏在中间以后，后面的车很快排成了一长队，大家只好一点一点从旁边慢慢过去。
孩子第一次近看这么大的货车时，连轮子都快比他高了，所以他站在边上看了很久都不想走。

example_translations.translation: As soon as that truck drove into the yard before dawn, the people waiting by the gate to collect things all walked over, because everyone was afraid it had come too late today.
After that truck broke down in the middle of the intersection, the vehicles behind it quickly formed a long line, and everyone had to inch past from the side.
When the child saw such a large truck up close for the first time, even the wheels were almost taller than he was, so he stood there watching for a long time and did not want to leave.

glosses.notes: To beat an opponent, difficulty, illness, or other challenge so that it no longer has the upper hand.

examples.sentence: 他们原来都觉得自己没有太大希望，可是最后还是在决赛里击败了去年最强的对手，让全场都站起来叫好。
医生说，想真正击败这种老病，光靠几天吃药还不够，生活习惯也得一点一点跟着改。
每一次击败困难以后，她都会比上一次更明白自己想走哪条路，所以后来再难也没有停下来。

example_translations.translation: They had all originally felt they did not have much hope, but in the end they still defeated last year's strongest opponent in the final, making the whole crowd rise to its feet and cheer.
The doctor said that if you want to truly defeat this long-standing illness, relying only on a few days of medicine is not enough; your daily habits also have to change little by little.
After defeating one difficulty after another, she became clearer each time about what road she wanted to take, so later on she did not stop even when things got harder.

glosses.notes: A fixed base, center, or main site where training, research, production, or operations are carried out.

examples.sentence: 队里把训练基地放在山脚下，不只是因为地方大，还因为大家每天上山下山正好可以一起练体力。
新基地建好以后，很多年轻人都回来找工作，原来安静的小地方也一天一天多了人和车。
研究人员这几年一直住在海边基地里，每天早上一起出门记天气、看风和海水到底是怎么变化的。

example_translations.translation: The team placed its training base at the foot of the mountain not only because the area was large, but also because the members could train their strength together by going up and down every day.
After the new base was built, many young people came back to look for work, and the small place that had once been quiet gradually filled with more people and vehicles.
The researchers have been living at the seaside base these past few years, going out together every morning to record the weather and see how the wind and seawater are changing.

glosses.notes: A vehicle powered by a motor rather than by human effort, especially in traffic rules and road management.

examples.sentence: 路边新加的牌子写得很清楚，这一段早晚最忙的时候机动车不能随便进，不然孩子过路太危险。
警察检查那辆机动车的时候，先看牌子和灯是不是都正常，再问司机为什么没有按规定停车。
小区里原来总有人把机动车停在门口，后来大家进出太不方便，只好重新画线安排它们的位置。

example_translations.translation: The new sign by the road is written very clearly: during the busiest hours in the morning and evening, motor vehicles cannot enter this section freely, otherwise it is too dangerous for children crossing.
When the police inspected that motor vehicle, they first checked whether its sign and lights were normal, and then asked the driver why he had not parked according to the rules.

People in the neighborhood used to keep parking motor vehicles by the gate, but later it became too inconvenient for everyone coming and going, so they had to redraw the lines and rearrange the spaces.

glosses.notes: Describes strong hunger, whether physical hunger itself or the state people feel when they have gone too long without enough food.

examples.sentence: 孩子在外面跑了一下午，刚一回家就饿得不想说话，那种饥饿的样子连坐下等饭都等不及。
书里写到那些人在最难的时候怎样忍着饥饿去找吃的时，教室里一下安静下来，谁都没有再动。
医生提醒年轻人不要总用忙来压住饥饿，因为身体到了晚上还是会把白天少吃的部分都找回来。

example_translations.translation: The child had been running around outside all afternoon, and as soon as he got home he was too hungry to talk. He looked so hungry that he could not even wait calmly after sitting down for the meal.
When the book described how those people endured hunger while searching for food in the hardest times, the classroom suddenly fell quiet and nobody moved again.
The doctor reminded young people not to keep using busyness to suppress hunger, because by evening the body will still come back looking for the part it did not get to eat during the day.

glosses.notes: To stir up interest, thought, energy, feeling, or motivation so that it becomes active.

examples.sentence: 老师没有直接告诉我们怎么写，而是先放了几张旧照片，希望这些真实画面能激发大家把心里话写出来。
父亲小时候常听爷爷讲那段路是怎么一点一点修好的，所以后来也被激发出想学这个的念头。
一场不算长的谈话，反而激发了她重新做这份工作的想法，回家以后连晚上都还在看怎么开始。

example_translations.translation: The teacher did not directly tell us how to write. Instead, she first showed several old photos, hoping those real images would inspire everyone to write out what was in their hearts.
When Father was little, he often listened to Grandfather talk about how that road had been repaired bit by bit, so later it sparked in him the desire to study this field.
A conversation that was not very long instead sparked in her the idea of doing this work again, and after going home she kept looking at how to get started even at night.

glosses.notes: Money set aside and managed for a particular purpose, such as education, public welfare, health, or investment.

examples.sentence: 学校决定把这笔基金先用在最旧的两栋楼上，因为一下雨，里面很多地方就会开始一点一点漏水。
她每个月发了工资都会先拿出一部分放进孩子的教育基金，哪怕钱不算多，也想早点准备。
新闻里说，那家医院收到新的公益基金以后，原来排了很久却没钱做手术的人终于能继续治了。

example_translations.translation: The school decided to use this fund first on the two oldest buildings, because once it rains, many parts inside them start leaking little by little.
Every month after getting paid, she takes out a portion first and puts it into her child's education fund. Even if the amount is not large, she still wants to start preparing early.
The news said that after the hospital received a new public-welfare fund, people who had been waiting a long time but had no money for surgery could finally continue treatment.

glosses.notes: To encourage someone strongly so they keep trying, improve, or continue moving toward a goal.

examples.sentence: 老师知道这几个孩子最近老觉得自己不行，所以每次有一点进步都认真说出来，想用这种方法激励他们继续学下去。
公司不是靠空话激励大家，而是把做得好的地方一条一条写清楚，让人知道努力到底有没有用。
母亲年轻时吃过很多苦，所以她常拿自己的经历激励我们，告诉我们慢一点也不要轻易放弃。

example_translations.translation: The teacher knew these children had lately kept feeling that they were not good enough, so every time they made even a little progress, she pointed it out carefully, hoping to motivate them to keep studying.
The company does not encourage people with empty talk. Instead, it writes down the things that were done well one by one, so people know whether their effort is really useful.
Mother went through many hardships when she was young, so she often uses her own experience to motivate us, telling us not to give up easily even if we move a little more slowly.

glosses.notes: Strong emotional energy, enthusiasm, or passionate drive toward a person, goal, idea, or activity.

examples.sentence: 导演刚开始说这部片子的时候眼里全是激情，连最怀疑的人听完以后都觉得也许真能拍成。
年轻的时候有激情当然很好，但是把一件大事做完，后面还是要一天一天坚持下去。
他唱到最后一段时突然放开了声音，那种激情一下把原来坐得很安静的观众也一起带动起来了。

example_translations.translation: When the director first started talking about this film, his eyes were full of passion, and even the people who had been the most doubtful felt after listening that it might really be made.
Having passion when you are young is of course a good thing, but to finish a major task, what comes later is still having to keep going day by day.
When he suddenly opened up his voice in the final section, that burst of passion instantly stirred even the audience members who had been sitting quietly.

glosses.notes: Can refer to machines and equipment, or describe something as mechanical, rigid, and lacking real thought or feeling.

examples.sentence: 厂里那套旧机械已经用了很多年，所以师傅每天开始工作以前都会先听一遍声音，怕哪里突然出问题。
如果只是机械地把老师的话背下来，不去想为什么这样做，过几天很容易又会全忘掉。
她的回答听起来太机械，像是早就准备好的，所以大家一听就知道她没有真正想过这个问题。

example_translations.translation: That set of old machinery in the factory has already been used for many years, so before starting work each day, the master worker first listens carefully to the sounds, afraid that something might suddenly go wrong.
If you only memorize the teacher's words mechanically without thinking about why things are done that way, it is very easy to forget everything again a few days later.
Her answer sounded too mechanical, as if it had been prepared long in advance, so everyone could tell at once that she had not truly thought through the question.

glosses.notes: A gene, especially when talking about inherited traits, disease risk, biology, or scientific research.

examples.sentence: 医生解释这种病和家里的基因可能有关系时，父亲先看了看孩子，然后很长时间都没有马上说话。
书里说，人的一些外表差别和基因有关，真正怎么长大也会一直受家里和习惯影响。
研究人员正在比对这几种植物的基因，希望找出它们为什么在同样天气里反应会完全不一样。

example_translations.translation: When the doctor explained that this illness might be related to the family's genes, the father first looked at the child and then remained silent for a long while.
The book says that some differences in people's outward appearance are connected with genes, and how someone actually grows up is also continually affected by family and habits.
The researchers are comparing the genes of these several kinds of plants, hoping to find out why they react completely differently in the same weather.

glosses.notes: A favorable opportunity or opening that appears and can be seized if someone is prepared for it.

examples.sentence: 很多人都看见了这次机遇，最后真正抓住的人，往往都是那些早就一点一点准备好的人。
对那个小城来说，高铁一开通就是新的机遇，因为年轻人出去和外面的人进来都方便得多。
老师常说，机遇来以前先把自己该会的东西学好，不然门开在眼前也不一定真的走得进去。

example_translations.translation: Many people saw this opportunity, but in the end the ones who truly seized it were usually those who had already prepared themselves little by little.
For that small city, the opening of the high-speed rail line was a new opportunity, because it suddenly became much easier for young people to go out and for people from outside to come in.

The teacher often says that before an opportunity arrives, you should first learn the things you ought to know, otherwise even if the door opens right in front of you, you may still not be able to walk through it.

glosses.notes: The working mechanism or set process through which something operates, is managed, or keeps functioning.

examples.sentence: 如果没有一个清楚的机制来检查问题出在哪里，同样的错下个月很可能还会再出现一次。
医院后来换了一套更快的预约机制，老人不用天没亮就站在门口排队，大家都觉得轻松多了。
老师拿班里的小事解释什么叫机制，说一个地方如果只靠某一个人，那往往就不算真正稳定。

example_translations.translation: If there is no clear mechanism for checking where a problem came from, the same mistake is very likely to appear again next month.
The hospital later changed to a faster appointment system, so older people no longer had to stand at the gate lining up before dawn, and everyone felt much more at ease.
The teacher used a small matter in the class to explain what a mechanism is, saying that if a place depends only on a single person, it usually does not count as truly stable.

glosses.notes: Used to introduce a condition that still does not change the main result, similar to saying even if or even though.

examples.sentence: 即便今天晚上就把计划全改完，明天一早开会的时候，我们也还是得先听听现场的人到底怎么说。
母亲常说，即便手里现在只有一点钱，也要先把最要紧的药和吃的准备好，别等以后再后悔。
即便朋友已经原谅了他，他心里还是一直过不去，因为那句话确实说得比平常重太多了。

example_translations.translation: Even if we finish changing the whole plan tonight, when the meeting starts early tomorrow morning, we still have to first hear what the people on site actually have to say.
Mother often says that even if you only have a little money in hand right now, you should first prepare the most essential medicine and food, and not wait until later to regret it.
Even though his friend had already forgiven him, he still could not get past it, because those words really had come out much harsher than usual.

glosses.notes: Can describe something as extreme or going too far, or refer to an extreme point, condition, method, or attitude.

examples.sentence: 医生提醒大家，天气一热一冷变化太大时，不要一下用极端的方法让身体马上跟着变，不然更容易出问题。
他年轻时说话常常很极端，不是全对就是全错，后来见的人多了，才知道事情没那么简单。
新闻里那种极端天气一来，山路、水、电和电话都会一起受影响，所以村里每年都提前做准备。

example_translations.translation: The doctor reminded everyone that when the weather swings too sharply between heat and cold, they should not use extreme methods to make the body change all at once, otherwise problems become more likely.
When he was young, he often spoke in extremes, as if everything were either entirely right or entirely wrong. Only after meeting more people did he realize things were not that simple.
Once that kind of extreme weather arrives, the mountain roads, water, electricity, and phone service are all affected together, so the village prepares early every year.

glosses.notes: To give immediate emergency help before full medical treatment becomes available.

examples.sentence: 那位护士跪在地上给老人急救的时候，旁边的人谁都不敢大声说话，只能赶快给车让路。
学校今年专门请医生来教大家最基本的急救方法，因为谁也不知道意外会不会就在身边发生。
孩子在水边滑倒以后，父亲先按自己学过的办法急救，再让旁边的人马上打电话找医生。

example_translations.translation: While the nurse knelt on the ground giving first aid to the old man, nobody nearby dared speak loudly; they could only hurry to clear the way for the vehicle.
This year the school specially invited a doctor to teach everyone the most basic first-aid methods, because nobody knows whether an accident might happen right beside them.
After the child slipped by the water, the father first gave emergency aid according to the method he had learned, and then told the people nearby to call a doctor immediately.

glosses.notes: Describes a strong urgent desire, anxious eagerness, or a feeling of wanting something to happen very soon.

examples.sentence: 母亲站在门口等消息的时候，脸上那种急切的样子让大家一看就知道她一夜都没有睡好。
他太急切地想证明自己已经准备好了，结果反而一开口就把最重要的话全都说乱了。
孩子们急切地围着老师问什么时候能看到结果，连平时最爱慢慢走的那个都一下跑到了最前面。

example_translations.translation: As Mother stood at the doorway waiting for news, the eager look on her face told everyone at a glance that she had not slept well all night.
He was too eager to prove that he was already prepared, and as a result he scrambled the most important things the moment he opened his mouth.
The children eagerly crowded around the teacher asking when they would be able to see the results, and even the one who usually loved walking slowly ran to the very front.

glosses.notes: A large group, organization, or corporate group made up of connected people, companies, or interests.

examples.sentence: 那家集团这几年越做越大，负责人每次回学校讲话，都还会先说最难的时候大家是怎么一点一点走过来的。
新闻里说，这个小工厂被大集团买下以后，原来怕没有工作的人后来反而有了新的机会。
她原来以为只有很大的集团才会有完整安排，进来以后才发现小地方也能把事情做得很细。

example_translations.translation: That corporate group has grown bigger and bigger in recent years, and every time the person in charge returns to speak at the school, he still begins by talking about how everyone made it through the hardest period little by little.
The news said that after this small factory was bought by a large group, the people who had once feared losing work later ended up with new opportunities instead.
She had originally thought that only very large groups would have complete arrangements, but after joining she discovered that even a small place can handle things in great detail.

glosses.notes: A formal way to say extremely or exceptionally, used to strengthen the degree of what follows.

examples.sentence: 老房子的门虽然看着普通，真要修起来却极为难，因为里面很多地方都不能乱动。
医生说，这种药对少数人可能极为有效，可是不是每个人都适合，所以一定要先看清自己的情况。
那位老师对时间极为认真，哪怕只晚了两分钟，也会先向整班解释为什么今天来得比平常晚。

example_translations.translation: Although the door of the old house looks ordinary, it is extremely hard to repair, because many places inside cannot be moved around carelessly.
The doctor said that this medicine may be extremely effective for a small number of people, but it is not suitable for everyone, so you must first understand your own condition clearly.
That teacher is extremely serious about time. Even if he is only two minutes late, he first explains to the whole class why he arrived later than usual today.

glosses.notes: Describes something as bringing good fortune, sounding favorable, or symbolizing luck and well-being.

examples.sentence: 老人过年最爱在门上贴写着吉祥话的红纸，因为他觉得一家人平安，比什么都更吉祥。
这只小鸟突然飞到窗边的时候，奶奶笑着说这是吉祥的好事，大家一下都笑了。
店里开门第一天，老板特意挑了一个自己觉得很吉祥的时间，希望这一年都能平平安安过去。

example_translations.translation: During the New Year, the old man most likes pasting red paper with auspicious phrases on the door, because he feels that a family's safety is more auspicious than anything else.
When that little bird suddenly flew to the window, Grandma smiled and said it was an auspicious good sign, and everyone immediately started smiling too.
On the first day the shop opened, the owner deliberately chose a time he felt was auspicious, hoping that the whole year would pass in peace and safety.

glosses.notes: Can mean inheriting property or position, or carrying on a skill, tradition, style, or way of doing things.

examples.sentence: 父亲走了以后，几个孩子坐下来认真谈怎么继承老房子，谁都不想因为钱把多年的感情弄坏。
她说自己从母亲那里继承的不只是做饭的方法，还有先让家里人安心的习惯。
父亲常说，继承家里的老做法不是把每一步都死记住，而是先明白为什么一定要这样做。

example_translations.translation: After Father passed away, the children sat down and seriously discussed how to inherit the old house, because none of them wanted money to damage years of family feeling.
She says that what she inherited from her mother was not only a way of cooking, but also the habit of putting family members at ease first.
Father often says that carrying on the family's old way does not mean memorizing every step by force, but first understanding why things have to be done that way.

glosses.notes: The person or team that finishes in third place in a competition.

examples.sentence: 他们原来只想先打进前几名，没想到最后居然拿到季军，连教练都在场边笑得一时说不出话。
孩子虽然只得了季军，回家的路上一直在笑，因为这是他第一次拿到这么好的结果。
学校运动会结束以后，那个拿到季军的班并没有难过，反而一直在研究明年怎么再往前走一步。

example_translations.translation: They had originally only wanted to make it into the top few places, but in the end they unexpectedly won third place, and even the coach was smiling speechless at the side of the field.
Although the child only came in third, he kept smiling on the way home, because it was the first time he had ever achieved such a good result.
After the school sports meet ended, the class that had taken third place was not upset at all. Instead, they kept discussing how to move one step further next year.

glosses.notes: The rules and self-control that keep a group orderly and keep people acting within agreed limits.

examples.sentence: 老师说，一个队如果只有热情没有纪律，那人再多也很难把事情做好，因为关键时候谁都不知道先听谁的。
第一天最让孩子们不习惯的不是早起，而是站队时那种一点小动作都没有的纪律要求。
公司最近反复强调开会纪律，不是想管得太细，而是大家已经因为迟到和跑题浪费了太多时间。

example_translations.translation: The teacher said that if a team has enthusiasm but no discipline, then no matter how many people it has, it will still be hard to do things well, because at the crucial moment nobody knows whose lead to follow first.
What felt most unfamiliar to the children on the first day was not getting up early, but the discipline requirement of standing in line without even small extra movements.

The company has been repeatedly emphasizing meeting discipline lately, not because it wants to control everything too tightly, but because people have already wasted too much time through lateness and going off topic.

glosses.notes: Describes loneliness, emotional emptiness, or the quiet feeling of being without company or connection.

examples.sentence: 孩子去外地上学以后，家里一下安静下来，母亲刚开始总觉得吃饭的时候特别寂寞，连电视都不想开。
他住在城里人最多的地方，下班回到只有自己一个人的房间时，还是会突然觉得很寂寞。
书里那个老人最让人难过的，不是他没有钱，而是他明明身边有人，却一直过得很寂寞。

example_translations.translation: After the child went away to study, the house suddenly became quiet, and at first Mother always felt especially lonely when eating, to the point that she did not even want to turn on the television.
He lives in the part of the city with the most people, yet when he gets off work and returns to a room where he is alone, he still suddenly feels very lonely.
What makes the old man in the book most sad is not that he has no money, but that although there are people around him, he still keeps living in loneliness.
